title: Chapter 229
text:
A secret meeting was taking place at the headquarters of Stardragon's Division 13. A few important members of Hesla's military intelligence department were there, and Gu Hui was there to receive them personally.

The expedition was imminent, and the Six Nations were in frequent contact to discuss the final details.

In the meeting room, both parties were whispering to each other.

Buzz!

The sudden vibration of a phone silenced everyone in the room. They all turned to look at the source of the sound with dissatisfaction.

Who was playing around in such a serious situation?

The source of the sound was the director of Division 13, Gu Hui. Everyone was confused. The Hesla people seemed to be saying, "Even the director of Stardragon is so unprofessional."

Gu Hui frowned. He had a few phones, but all of them were switched off during meetings. Only the most important calls would be made to this phone.

Gu Hui took out his phone and looked at the caller ID. His eyes narrowed, and he said in a low voice, "Pause the meeting. I need to take this call."

After that, Gu Hui left in a hurry with his phone. He did not care about the reaction of the others.

The Hesla people were shocked. The director of Division 13 had abandoned an important meeting to take a call. Who was calling?

Who was so important? Could it be the leader of the higher-ups? Why did he not use the internal line?

Gu Hui went to the quiet room next door and answered the call. "Why are you calling?"

"Are you surprised?" Han Xiao's teasing voice came from the phone.

The number that Han Xiao used to call Gu Hui was naturally the identity of 'Zero'. Ever since the information leak, he had become an important target of Stardragon.

Ever since the Dark Crow Valley battle, Han Xiao had disappeared without a trace. Stardragon's intelligence department could not find any trace of him. Gu Hui would not miss this precious opportunity to communicate with him. In order to answer Han Xiao's call, he did not mind canceling an important meeting.

"What do you want this time?" After their previous contact, Gu Hui had a general understanding of Han Xiao's character. He was purposeful and would not call just for pleasantries. Hence, he went straight to the point.

"I want to meet someone."

"Who?"

"His name is … Wait, let me check the bounty list. Oh, her codename is Yi Yeqing. She's a pharmacist."

Gu Hui was taken aback. He instructed his secretary to investigate this person and soon, the results were out.

Yi Yeqing, whose ability was to control plants, was a top-notch Pharmacist. She had once used an untested medicine to spread a strong contagious disease, causing a large number of casualties. As a result, she was put on a bounty by various countries. A few years ago, she was arrested and was currently locked up in Bell of Death Island.

Bell of Death Island was a prison used by the Six Nations to imprison criminals. It was located alone in the sea with mysterious coordinates and tight security.

"What do you want her to do?" Gu Hui was puzzled.

"I have something to do," Han Xiao said.

Gu Hui muttered, "Even I can't casually take people from Bell of Death Island. It's against the rules."

This was a tactful rejection.

Han Xiao laughed and suddenly changed the topic. "I heard that you guys are going to start an expedition. Tsk, tsk, the Six Nations are going to join forces and attack Andrea from more than ten directions. There are aircraft carriers, planes, and everything else. What a huge force. Do you think the Germinal Organization will just sit back and wait?"

He tightened his grip on the phone.

"What information do you have?"

"Heh, I have plenty of information. The location of the base, military strength, missile deployment, and all kinds of inhumane plans of the Germinal Organization …"

Han Xiao's tone annoyed Gu Hui, but he had no choice but to fall into the trap. "Emerald Grass is yours …" he said with a deep voice.

"Okay." Han Xiao agreed without hesitation. Originally, he had planned to give all the information about the Germinal Organization to the Six Nations before the war to increase the Six Nations' advantage. Now, it was a good opportunity to exchange for someone he needed.

In Version 2.0, Yi Yeqing was an important character in Blue Star. As a top-notch Pharmacist, she had researched the Mutation Virus and created the medicine to suppress the virus, which had played a significant role.

In Han Xiao's previous life, Bell of Death Island was a mysterious place, and no players had found the coordinates. However, in Version 2.0, the players were able to find a piece of information. The Mutation Virus had spread and affected Bell of Death Island, leading to a dangerous situation. However, the criminals locked up in the prison of the Six Nations had solved the disaster and escaped from Bell of Death Island. Yi Yeqing had escaped during this crisis.

As the saying went, the prison was always full of crouching tigers and hidden dragons. The prisoners who had been locked up for many years rushed out and became the new characters in Version 2.0. They were like dragons crossing the river, overturning the original situation when the disaster was spreading.

"The information will be sent to you gradually. I will decide on the location of Yi Yeqing." After that, Han Xiao hung up the phone.

Gu Hui's expression changed a few times. Only Han Xiao dared to hang up on him, and he could not do anything about it.

A prisoner in exchange for key information, this was definitely a good deal.

Furthermore, Gu Hui also realized another benefit.

"He has disappeared for so long. This meeting is a good opportunity to find out where he is!"

Han Xiao was still on the Agent File. Where he had gone, what he had done, and whether he had joined any organization were all mysteries that Stardragon was curious about. This was a good opportunity to investigate.

…

In the workshop of Sanctuary Three, after hanging up the phone, Han Xiao waited for thirty seconds and sent the first set of information to Division 13. He kept the rest for the time being. He knew that he could not hand over all the information in one go.

If I can get Yi Yeqing this time, not only can I get her to help with the research of the medicine, but I can also make Sanctuary Three the first place to suppress the Mutation Virus in Version 2.0. With my name on the sanctuary, the safer it is, the greater my influence will be …

But Stardragon knows that Yi Yeqing has been swapped with me, and they will not give up this opportunity. If they find out that Yi Yeqing is working here, they will guess that Black Phantom is me, and my identity will be exposed …

Thinking about the pros and cons, Han Xiao suddenly realized something. He had hidden his identity because he was weak, but now, with the Dark Net behind him, he stood at the top of the planet and did not need to hide from his enemies. At the same time, the Germinal Organization was facing destruction and could not even take care of itself, so it did not matter if he hid his identity or not.

He was suddenly enlightened.

Unknowingly, his old enemy was no longer a giant in his eyes and had grown to the point where he could face the most powerful organization on the planet.

Looking at it from another perspective, exposing his identity could combine the influence of Zero and Black Phantom. He was eighty percent sure that he would get Legendary Points, and the players' impression of him would improve.

With his own deeds, the players might mistake him as the main character of Blue Star and steal Bennett's limelight.

Let's play it safe first. About my identity, I'll think about it after the war. Although he saw the benefits, Han Xiao decided to play it by ear. He felt that he was never reckless.

The Energy Block Refiner was still working. Han Xiao locked the door and left, patrolling the construction site with his hands behind his back.

When he passed by the city wall construction area, he suddenly heard a commotion. He paused and walked over.

The construction team was surrounding a large crane, and when they saw Han Xiao approaching, they greeted him respectfully.

"What's wrong?" Han Xiao asked.

"The crane is malfunctioning and can't be started. We can't find the reason," someone said helplessly.

Han Xiao heard this and thought, Wow, isn't fixing cars his specialty? He rolled up his sleeves and said eagerly, "Bring me all the tools."

The construction team then remembered that their boss was a mechanic, so they hurriedly moved the parts and tools over. Han Xiao climbed up the crane to check the malfunction. He quickly found the problem and picked up the tools to fix it. His hands moved up and down like shadows, and his speed was shocking.

The construction players beside him were shocked.

His hand speed was at least fifty years of being single!

"So, single people have an advantage playing mechanics," one of the players said proudly. "I'm the man who's going to be the Machine King!"

"You've made up your mind."

As he repaired, Han Technician decided to strengthen the crane on a whim.

He turned the last screw.

Done!

Han Xiao clapped his hands and let the construction team try to start it. The strengthened crane seemed to have taken an aphrodisiac. It twitched up and down vigorously and smashed the ground loudly. The construction team could not keep up with the rhythm and hurriedly dodged. It was chaos.

At this time, the player welding the steel bars on the city wall suddenly looked at the wilderness and shouted, "Someone's coming."

Han Xiao quickly walked up the scaffolding on the city wall and looked into the distance.

A group of people in ragged clothes appeared in the wilderness and slowly walked toward the sanctuary.
